description:
Buen Font Installer is the fastest way to install fonts on your Mac. Just drag and drop font files or folders anywhere onto the app window — it handles the rest.

Features:
• Drag and drop .ttf and .otf fonts directly into ~/Library/Fonts
• Drop entire folders to batch install all fonts at once
• Organize mode: sort fonts into TTF, OTF, WOFF, and WOFF2 subfolders without installing
• Skips fonts that are already installed
• Lives in your menu bar for quick access
• Works entirely offline — no internet connection required
